name: hexdump
description: Hex + ASCII dump of text, 16 bytes per row, the way `xxd`/`hexdump -C` render one (C). WHEN TO USE: inspecting opaque or partly-binary tool output (a hash, a compressed blob, an unclear encoding) that would otherwise print as unreadable or invisible bytes. Input: {"text": "...", "max_bytes": 4096} (bare text may be passed unwrapped; max_bytes caps how much is dumped, default and ceiling 4096).
llm_description: Hex+ASCII dump of text, 16 bytes/row (like xxd/hexdump -C), for inspecting opaque or partly-binary output. {"text":"...","max_bytes":4096} (default and ceiling 4096); text may be passed bare, unwrapped.

max_bytes.description: Caps how much of text is dumped. Defaults to 4096.
